body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose one creature within 6 units. On a success, deal 1 Arcane damage.

surges.html: On a success, leave a persistent aetheric sigil on the target and apply Distorted.
Extend a non-Concentration duration of this spell through the end of your next turn.

rider.title: AETHER THREAD
rider.html: After resolving this Action, create a Thread. Consume this Thread before resolving a future Magecraft Action to treat 1 damage from it as Breach.
